svg.aria-label: Parallel-sets diagram of the Titanic passengers across travel class, sex, age group, and survival outcome
svg.title: Who survived the Titanic
svg.desc: A parallel-sets (parcats) diagram routing 1,316 Titanic passengers across four categorical axes — travel class, sex, age group, and outcome. Each ribbon's width is the number of people on that path, and its colour is the outcome: blue for survived, red for died. Women and children survived far more than men, and first class far more than third. Hover a ribbon to highlight one path.
svg.text: Sex and age decided far more than the fare: women and children lived, third-class men did not
1,316 passengers · ribbon width = number of people on that path · colour = outcome
